name: iOS (Human Interface Guidelines)
description: iOS apps following Apple Human Interface Guidelines accessibility
guidelines: Apple HIG: Minimum 44×44pt touch targets for all interactive elements
Apple HIG: Respect Dynamic Type scaling — design at Body (17pt) baseline
Apple HIG: Custom fonts are fine but must support UIFontMetrics for Dynamic Type
Apple HIG: Respect safe area insets — no interactive content behind Dynamic Island (59pt) or home indicator (34pt)
